story_theme_en: Mom bought 1 pizza and divided it among her three children. Lin got 1/3 of the pizza, Mali got 1/4 of the pizza, and Book got the rest. Who got the most pizza, and how much did they get?
helper_tip: When comparing fractions, make the denominators the same first
hint_th: เวลาเปรียบเทียบเศษส่วน ให้ทำส่วนให้เท่ากันก่อนเสมอ
think_story_en: Lin gets 1/3 = 4/12 of the pizza. Mali gets 1/4 = 3/12 of the pizza. Book gets 1 - 4/12 - 3/12 = 5/12 of the pizza. So Book got the most at 5/12, then Lin at 4/12, and Mali at 3/12.
